name: FadeBench
description: Measure incremental moral drift in small local models: four-decision ladders, each paired with the same final decision asked cold, sent to a /v1/completions server.
compatibility: Calls a model server's /v1/completions endpoint (default http://127.0.0.1:8003) and renders prompts itself in gemma4, gemma4_think, chatml, phi3 or mistral chat formats.
limitations: A research benchmark with pre-registered criteria, not a leaderboard: the runner only records what was shown and what came back; drift is scored afterwards from the logs under written rubrics in docs/SCORING_GUIDANCE_GRADIENT.md.
The paper's baselines cover four open models of roughly 4B to 12B parameters on low-key fantasy scenes; results on other models, sizes or settings are untested.
Item and scenario files end with a canary line that must be deleted before running; 11 of the 71 item files have redacted authoring notes, listed in docs/RELEASE_COPIES_20261028.md.
Needs Python 3 with the requests package and a separately running model server; the benchmark includes no model.
Run by the maintainers on Windows; other platforms are untested.
Apache-2.0 grants no rights to the FadeBench name, and modified redistributions must mark their changes, so altered items stay identifiable.

sources.note: What the benchmark measures (incremental drift, paired acute controls, anti-bias controls), the runner entry point, the canary line to delete before running, the redacted item files, and the Apache-2.0 terms on the name and on marking changes.

The runner reads items and bands from files, calls a model server's /v1/completions endpoint (default http://127.0.0.1:8003), uses the requests package, records outputs without computing scores, and offers the gemma4, gemma4_think, chatml, phi3 and mistral chat formats.
The Zenodo paper (a preprint, not peer reviewed): four small open models (about 4B to 12B), fantasy scenes, the ladder-versus-cold design and its pre-registered results.
One of the Figure 1 run manifests, recording the platform the runs used: "platform": "Windows-11-10.0.26200-SP0".
